reasons.claim: Notified regeneration felling, small polygon (0.73 ha), status notified; no completed felling overlap (0%).

Four eligible species (all VU, fungi, site-bound, forest-associated, with threats including lack of continuity forest, lack of large/old trees and ground disturbance from forestry) within 250 m: Hydnellum scabrosum (6 records, nearest 3 m, 2026), Hydnellum gracilipes (40 m, 2026), Phellodon secretus (72 m, 2026), Tricholoma matsutake (158 m, 2026).
Eleven site-bound forest NT species also recorded within 250 m, including Hydnellum ferrugineum and H. caeruleum with records at 0 m (inside the polygon, 2022).
Effort is adequate (329 records, 92nd percentile vs county median 33). Near-site 2 records inside the polygon and 60 within 250 m across 9 observation days.

uncertainties: Fungal fruiting records show presence on observation days, not whether the mycelium or habitat remains on the felling area.
The polygon is small (equivalent radius 48 m), so the position of records relative to the boundary matters a lot; most eligible records are outside it.
not_established: Whether the threatened fungi occupy the polygon itself
Forest condition or biodiversity of the site
next_action: Reviewer should map the 2026 Hydnellum/Phellodon records (3 m to 158 m) against the polygon boundary and arrange a field inventory before felling begins.
